'''Omega 379''' was the largest [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[MZX32905 system/Legends|MZX32905 star system]]. [[Dician]] ordered her crew to wait for retrieval on the asteroid after they destroyed [[Alema Rar]]'s [[The Home|base]].
